feedback: Looks good, works good, however you have the columns on the list too tightly packed in there.  In this case, you've got the whole screen width to work with, but there was only 1-2 characters between each column which makes it hard to read.  I'm not suggesting that the columns be equally spaced or anything, but the column padding should expand depending on the available width.  1 char for the tightest situations, and who knows, maybe 5 chars (spaces) when there is lots of space.
